description: This file defines the AdminModuleController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Admin plugin. It handles the default admin module request by redirecting to the admin module's default path.

classes.name: AdminModuleController
classes.description: Handles administrative module logic, specifically redirecting to the admin default page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by obtaining the default admin module path and executing a redirect to that path.
